definitions.gloss: beveling; rounding off edges (of vegetables or wood)
definitions.explanation: Shaving the sharp edges off cut vegetables so they keep their shape when simmered, or off the corners of wood or furniture (chamfering).

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面取|めんと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To bevel the edges of the daikon pieces.

examples.japanese: {面取|めんと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{煮崩|にくず}れしにくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Beveling the edges keeps the pieces from breaking apart as they simmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{面取|めんと}り⟦してある→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧だ。
examples.english: The corners of this desk are beveled, so it's safe even if a child bumps into it.

notes:
USAGE:
In cooking, done to root vegetables such as ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧, potatoes and pumpkin before they go into a simmered dish (⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧). In carpentry, the same word means chamfering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面取|めんと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bevel the edges
- {面取|めんと}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧: daikon with beveled edges

RELATED WORDS:
- {煮崩|にくず}れ: falling apart while simmering
